先聖 is rendered Confucius (idiomatic) and the ancient sage (literal); packet renderings used as-is.
天慶, 天會, 皇統, 天德 and 宣和 are not in the packet's reign table (only 大安 is); all dates kept unresolved.
The convict list names 翟詢 (Zhai Xun) but the sentence list has 霍詢 (Huo Xun); treated as the same person (strongly inferred), with 霍詢 as a variant surface.
唐括安禮 is rendered Tangutuo Anli; the packet gives no other romanization, so the rendering is kept and used as the label.
璋 (Zhang), granted the jinshi degree with Gui's recall, is probably another son of Cai Songnian, but the packet does not state it; no kinship claim was made.
儀同三司 is again rendered Pillar of the State, Third Class; left unrepaired and cited with the Chinese.
十年 is rendered 'ten years later'; it may be an era year following 天會間, but it is kept as the source text with no conversion.
蔡正甫 (Cai Zhengfu) is Cai Gui by his courtesy name 正甫 (s0081); linked as a local person record with a note.
宣、政 is rendered Xuanhe and Zhenghe; the dates are not in the packet's reign table and are kept unresolved.
荊王文 is rendered 'Jing Wangwen'; 荊王 may be a princely title (Prince of Jing) with personal name 文. The packet rendering is kept as the label and the zh is surfaced as a title-reference.
Wang Jing, styled Wujing (無競), may be the same person as Wang Wujing (王無競), Guo Changqian's friend in chunk 003 (s0143). Not merged.
二年 (s0207), 是歲 (s0214) and 四年 (s0216) are relative years; the reign table has no entries for 皇統 or 大定.
大安三年: the packet's only reign-table entry is liao-daan (Liao, 1085-1094), but the Liao polity ends in 1125 per the packet and this is a Jin-court date, so it is left unresolved rather than mapped.
金源 in 金源二子 is read as a title-reference to Hong, magistrate of Jinyuan (s0259). Strongly inferred.
皇太子 (s0280) is linked to Xianzong (顯宗, s0279), for whom Zidan served as left mentor to the crown prince. Strongly inferred.
The emperor (上) in s0249-s0253 and s0297-s0302 is not named; claims are attached only to named persons. s0297 names Zhangzong as the speaker's context.
